description:
tools.preview reports allowed: true, approval_required: false and no blockers for three calls the commit then refuses, including confirming a sales order that is pending approval (LOW)

What happened (2026-10-23 ~06:00 UTC, MCP as team07, read-only previews on our own fixtures):
- tools.preview {name: "SalesOrder.confirm", arguments: {id: ae0aefa7 (SO-2026-00170, status
  draft, approval_status pending_approval)}} → allowed true, approval_required false, blockers [].
  The real SalesOrder.confirm on this order (2026-10-22) was refused by the guard
  "approval_status != pending_approval/rejected".
- tools.preview Quotation.make.SalesOrder on QTN-2026-00037 (draft) → allowed true, blockers [],
  would_create a SalesOrder. The real call (2026-10-22) was refused: "Submit or accept the
  quotation first". Same preview on QTN-2026-00033 (ks) and QTN-2026-00088/89 (su, read-only).
- tools.preview Quotation.submit_for_margin_approval.draft.pending_approval on QTN-2026-00037
  → allowed true. The real call (2026-10-22) was refused: quotation_margin_floor_not_configured.
Preview does catch state errors correctly (e.g. Deal.qualify on a closed_lost deal →
invalid_state). It lists checks_not_run ("conditions evaluated at commit"), but the approval
state and the quote's own status are plain fields on the record, and approval_required: false is
a positive statement that is false.

Expected: preview reports the approval guard and the make-route status guard as blockers (or at
least approval_required: true on a pending_approval record), as the tool description promises
"blockers with codes".
Impact: an agent that previews before acting (as the platform advises) is told the call is safe,
then gets refused; or it tells a user an order can be confirmed when it is waiting on approval.
Reproduce: the three tools.preview calls above (read-only).
Scope checked: SalesOrder.confirm on ks SO-00170 (only pending draft SO); make.SalesOrder on 2
draft quotes per instance.
Related: 01201a71 (pending approval not enforced on send/confirm).
Fixtures: none new.
